scope: german, attack=none; human and chatgpt/gpt4 sampling with repetition_penalty=no
selection_method: Sort eligible source_id values by SHA-256(seed + :select: + source_id); take first 500. Sort selected sources by SHA-256(seed + :split: + source_id); first 250 development, remaining 250 evaluation. Hash inputs use UTF-8.
language_basis: RAID domain=german; no independent language classifier used
